# IV. DIRECT MIMO QFT DESIGN I

The MIMO QFT design technique provides a design procedure to synthesize a fixed diagonal controller transfer matrix G(s) and prefilter F(s) to satisfy specifications on the closed-loop system shown in Fig.2, where P(s) is the MIMO uncertain plant.

The basic principle for MIMO QFT design is to convert the MIMO control system into a set of equivalent

MISO control systems. Using fixed-point theorem, the MIMO control problem for an m × m system can be converted into m equivalent single-loop MISO problems, each with two inputs and one output.
